description: Get the PDF of a document as base64-encoded binary (Holded API v2). Returns { contentType, base64, bytes, filename }. Supported docTypes: invoice, salesreceipt, creditnote, receiptnote, estimate, proform, salesorder, waybill, purchaseorder. purchase is NOT supported — GET /purchases/{id}/pdf returns 404 for all purchases. purchaserefund has no CRUD support in v2.

docType.description: Type of document (purchase is not supported — PDF endpoint returns 404)

name: get_document_pdf
